If you’re relying solely on spell-check to elevate your essay, you’re likely hitting a ceiling you can’t see. Most students think editing is about fixing typos, but that’s only half the battle. 

Here is the reality of the grading gap:

THE 54% TRAP: Relying purely on basic grammar checkers that overlook weak topic sentences, contradictory claims, and unformatted citation pinpoints. You end up with a grammatically correct but logically hollow paper.

THE 78% BLUEPRINT: Substantive developmental editing. This is where we look at line-by-line academic register refinement, restructuring weak paragraphs, and ensuring every single sentence aligns perfectly with your university’s specific grading rubric.
